phases.reason: propagation declared out of scope (expected.propagation_result: not_checked): the parking orbit is not required to be propagated

checks.label: Parking-orbit propagation
checks.reason: propagation not requested (expected result: 'not_checked'); the scenario declares propagation out of scope, but an out-of-scope declaration never waives a required physical check (E5-04: E2-04's declared-out-of-scope parking propagation is exactly what this gate must not pass)

physical.rule: all five physical checks are required for a computed mission: failed if any check failed; else not_checked if any check carries no evidence (absent evidence is never a pass, and an out-of-scope declaration does not waive a required check); passed only when every check passed

full_mission.rule: full mission failed if any applicable phase failed; else not_checked if any applicable phase is not_checked (absent evidence is never a pass); passed only when every applicable phase passed; a phase the mission does not fly is not applicable and never blocks the verdict

assumptions: FL-304 recovery: FL-302 boostback/entry script + FL-303 landing burn (FL-305 closed-loop guidance unless plan_options select the single G-FOLD plan), integrated through the FL-301 propagator; the booster track replaces the ballistic stage1_debris track
entry q limit 250000 Pa, entry g limit 12.0 g over the post-boostback descent window (DESIGN ASSUMPTIONs unless overridden)

R-01 landing-aware objective: corridor miss soft-constrained against a 1000 m landing-divert budget, corridor propellant against landing need + reserve + 2500 kg fuel margin (DESIGN ASSUMPTIONs unless overridden)

FOH discretization (n nodes, h = tof/n, terminal node = engine cutoff state a short distance above the pad; ballistic coast from there); trapezoidal fuel accounting against sea-level Isp (pessimistic end).

guidance: design_throttle=0.9 v_td=1.5m/s tilt<=30deg ignition=0.0s cutoff=none after insertion; insertion plan fuel_planned=6837.5kg

R-05/E3-01 actuator margins (20 deg/s TVC slew limit, 0.2 s TVC lag, lag-compensated command, 30 deg tilt limit, throttle slew unlimited): burn 21.2s; ignition headroom 64.1%, min throttle headroom 64.1%, floor room 13.6%, min tilt margin 11.8 deg, peak slew 19.2 deg/s (limit 20 deg/s, lag 0.2s (compensated)), throttle slew unlimited, ceiling riding 0.0s, floor riding 0.0s

mission.title: Reproducible full-physical reference mission (computed ascent + parking + booster RTLS)

warnings: ascent is replayed from a flown run directory: that flight's launch window and ascent optimization are not re-graded here (recorded not_checked, never passed)
RAAN unconstrained: the liftoff epoch is the configured date, not an in-plane node pass

expected.propagation_result is 'not_checked': a passing M-05 report is not required for the mission to pass, but the E5-04 physical gate keeps parking_propagation required (a declaration is not evidence)

recovery: the first stage flies the FL-302/FL-303(/FL-305) chain after separation and is merged into the run; recovery.landed must be green for the mission to pass (an unassessed landing -- solver stack missing -- is reported failed with its reason code, never as a pass)

label: e5-05-reference-two-stage-leo-rtls: liftoff -> meco -> separation -> booster recovery -> seco (branched after separation: upper stage + first stage) -> parking orbit -> orbit propagation

analytical.cannot_prove: that the model represents reality -- the closed-form reference shares the model's own assumptions (point mass, impulsive burns, idealised field).
analytical.label: Analytic solution
analytical.proves: the numerics reproduce the closed-form solution of the model they integrate (the equations and the integrator, not their agreement with reality).

design_input.cannot_prove: anything about fidelity to reality: the reference IS the design input, so this is NOT independent validation and must never be read as historical proof.
design_input.label: Matches design input
design_input.proves: the solver reached the aim point, or the plan respects the site/vehicle/corridor envelope it was designed against -- internal consistency only.

historical_telemetry.cannot_prove: any other vehicle, phase or operating point -- one published event validates that event, not the model as a whole, and the reference's own provenance is only as good as its source.
historical_telemetry.label: Historical telemetry
historical_telemetry.proves: the model reproduces a published, observed (flown) value it was not tuned to.

independent_model.cannot_prove: that either model is right in the real world -- an assumption shared by both stays invisible; the phase and force inventory of the comparison bound its reach.
independent_model.label: Independent model
independent_model.proves: two independently formulated models agree, so neither is trivially mis-implemented.

numerical_consistency.cannot_prove: agreement with any other model or with reality -- it bounds numerical error only.
numerical_consistency.label: Numerical consistency
numerical_consistency.proves: integration error is under tolerance and the model's own invariants / self-consistency hold (step convergence, exact integrals, a same-model re-fly).
